十月中 is the middle of the tenth month, as the literal field of this unit renders it ('It was the tenth month'); 'mid-autumn' misstates it.

斡不死: the packet names the chief 斡不 (Wobu, s0053), so the clause reads 'Wobu died', not 'did not die'; repaired in both fields, and his death is marked strongly inferred.
烏古乃 (Wugunai) is kept as a separate person; the packet does not identify him with anyone else.
奚王回離保 is rendered 'Xiwang Huilibao'; 奚王 may be a title, but the packet rendering is kept as the label.
明年 and 世祖初 (s0030) are relative dates; the packet reign table is empty, so they are UR.
吾父 / 汝父 (s0097, s0099) are linked to Jingzu, who made Wuchun chief (s0093); strongly inferred.
This Shilu (石魯, Buhui's follower) is a different person from the Shilu of s0006 (chunk 001).
巴的懣 is rendered 'Bade's Man'; kept as the packet renders it (no self-made romanization).
The arson charge against Huandu is only cross-referred to the Huandu biography; no further detail is in this unit.
Wuchun's (possessive) is the same Wuchun; the candidate is a duplicate span of his name.
修武校尉 is rendered 'Xiuzhou Captain'; kept as the packet renders it.
The English 'Song' in s0166 is 嵩 prefecture, not the Song state (宋) of s0165.

劾魯古 the pursuer (s0204) is not identified by the packet with 劾魯古, Dun'en's grandfather (s0219); they are separate people.
勃堇 is rendered 'Bolie' in these names and 'beljen' in s0219, but 'tribal chief' elsewhere in the chapter (s0055). Labels keep the packet's rendering here.
妻子 covers wife and children; the wife is recorded, and the unnamed children are not a separate person.

Machan is linked as Lapei's brother from 'Lapei and his brothers' in this unit together with their joint actions; strongly inferred. The explicit 'younger brother' wording is in s0169, outside this chunk.
The packet says there were two men named Hezhe. The father of Sagai is separate from Hezhe Bolie who held A Shu City (s0270, s0272).
吾父 in Shizu's speech is linked to Jingzu, whom this chunk names as served alongside Shizu by Ahai and who, in the speech, raised Wuchun. Strongly inferred.
The packet says A Shu died in Liao (s0289) and also that he was captured in Tianfu 6 (s0291). Both are recorded as written.
太師 in s0278 ('your Grand Preceptor') is not identified with Shizu's title in s0256; left as a title.
詐都勃堇 of the Toudan is the same 詐都 who surrendered in s0246; one person in this chunk.
天複 and 天輔 (s0325) are different era names. The packet renders both as Tianfu. They are kept as the source texts and not converted.
大定間 is a reign phrase in the eulogy. The packet reign table for this chapter is empty, so it is not mapped. Yaoli, Bode, Aoli, Meizhi and Chuai are clan surnames, not individuals.
遼太祖, the Liao founding emperor, is not the Jin Taizu of s0310.
乙列 is rendered Yilie, the same English as 乙烈 in s0282. The characters differ, so this is a separate person.
奚王回離保 is rendered Xiwang Huilibao. 奚王 may be a title (king of the Xi); the packet rendering is kept as the label.
